item.title: Deadly shooting in Paris suburb investigated as terrorism, officials say
item.description: A gunman opened fire from his car in the Paris suburb of Trappes on Friday, in what authorities described as a racially motivated act of terrorism.

item.title: German teen arrested on suspicion of murder in connection with US girl's death
item.description: The 18-year-old is accused of manipulating an Indiana teen over a social platform, according to prosecutors in Germany.
